t: The Rize exposed single outlet thermostatic mixer shower valve provides reliable and consistent water temperature for various bathroom installations. Constructed from durable chrome-plated brass, this exposed bar valve features separate flow and temperature controls for precise adjustment, with a 50°C safety cut-out to ensure a safe and efficient showering experience. It is suitable for both high and low pressure systems, making it a versatile choice for new builds and renovation projects. The modern design integrates seamlessly into contemporary bathrooms.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
